Reserved Mac account: signed Agent lifecycle, audits 2314 and 1786

All cases start not_run. Generation reads/hashes local artifacts and writes a
private plan; it does not install an app, launch a process, use launchctl, change
login items, access Keychain or log anyone out. Only the named owner executes the
commands below on reserved Mac serial @SERIAL@, hardware UUID @UUID@, account
@ACCOUNT@, UID @UID@. Never use the developer's current account or installed Agent.
The account must contain no Agent, registration, deployed apps, identity or personal
credentials before the test. Keep another administrator/recovery session available.

Acceptance is an actual signed bundle and ServiceManagement/launchd lifecycle.
The isolated AgentRelauncher subprocess check proves the 500ms acknowledgement
window and 10s hung-quit watchdog; it does not prove AppKit, LaunchServices, login,
bundle replacement, privacy permissions, native app adoption or launchd supervision.
Windows/Linux and hardware permission dialogs are outside this procedure.

Prepare and qualify the exact packages

1. Supply inventory.json with trial (32 lowercase hex), source_commit and
   origin_source_commit (full SHAs); cli_binary; origin_bundle, origin_zip,
   candidate_bundle, candidate_zip; installed_bundle; endpoint; reserved_account_empty
   true; mac {serial,hardware_uuid,os_build,owner,account,uid}; records
   {identity,empty_account,authorization,signing,origin_build,candidate_build,recovery}.
   All records are existing nonempty local files. Do not put tokens or private
   signing keys in the inventory. ZIPs must each contain one top-level app; their
   executable, Info.plist and embedded launch-agent plist must match the separately
   inventoried bundle. Candidate and origin executable hashes must differ, even
   if WLWendyAgentVersion is the same. Retain actual signing TeamIdentifier,
   designated requirement, hardened-runtime/notarization result, source revision,
   architecture, build command and source-to-package provenance in the records.

2. Generate outside any checkout:
     python3 mac-agent-lifecycle-rehearsal.py inventory.json NEW_PRIVATE_OUTPUT
   Both inputs stay in archival directories outside the installed destination.
   Do not modify a sealed package after signing. On the reserved Mac verify each
   archival app with /usr/bin/codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 APP,
   /usr/sbin/spctl --assess --type execute --verbose=4 APP, and record the actual
   /usr/bin/codesign -dv --verbose=4 APP output. Both must be Developer ID signed
   by the same expected team with sh.wendy.WendyAgentMac identity and compatible
   native architecture. An ad-hoc dev escape hatch does not pass this signed case.
   Verify all plan artifact hashes again immediately before any action. A rebuilt
   artifact requires a new plan. Never disable Gatekeeper, SIP or signature checks.

3. Log into the reserved Aqua account. Read, do not change, its identity:
     /usr/bin/id -u
     /usr/bin/id -un
     /usr/bin/sw_vers -buildVersion
     /usr/sbin/ioreg -rd1 -c IOPlatformExpertDevice
   Match UID @UID@, account @ACCOUNT@, the pinned OS build, serial and UUID above.
   Record a missing `launchctl print gui/@UID@/sh.wendy.WendyAgentMac`, missing
   installed path @INSTALLED@ and no WendyAgentMac processes owned by this UID.
   Inspect System Settings Login Items as well: no preexisting legacy main-app or
   launch-agent entry may be reused. If anything exists, stop and reserve a fresh
   account; do not remove unrelated state or reset the system background-task DB.

4. With explicit owner installation authorization, create only this account's
   Applications directory if needed and use /usr/bin/ditto ORIGIN_APP @INSTALLED@
   while the destination is absent. Verify the copied app's signature and executable
   hash @ORIGIN@. Do not copy into /Applications or overwrite an existing app. Keep
   recovery packages outside that path. Use generated open-installed. Grant only
   owner-approved prompts; record permission state without changing TCC databases.
   Prepare the new private CLI profile at @OUT@/cli-config for this exact localhost
   Agent; approve its independently observed identity as required. No existing user
   CLI profile or Keychain reference may be copied. The generated commands always
   select this private profile and the explicit loopback endpoint.
   Generate the output as this reserved account, or regenerate there from the
   reviewed inventory: the private output, CLI profile, heartbeat project and future
   receipt must be owned and writable by UID @UID@. Verify ownership and access
   before deployment; do not loosen another account's directory permissions.

Launchd persistence and duplicate prevention: 2314

5. Within 75s require generated job output to show one running launchd PID and the
   installed executable path. Record PID, UID and `ps -p PID -o pid=,ppid=,lstart=,command=`;
   confirm it belongs to this account and the exact installed executable. Require
   generated info success and exactly one Agent process for this installed app.
   Startup handoff may temporarily have two processes; after the deadline it must
   converge to one. Open the same installed app again using generated open-installed.
   The temporary outside-launchd process must hand off/quit without a second listener.
   Record launchd and Agent logs around registration; persistent EX_CONFIG/fallback
   to an unsupervised process does not satisfy this supervision case.

6. Only after the exact job/path/PID checks, run generated crash-owned-agent. This
   sends SIGABRT to that named job, never a saved PID or a process-name kill. Within
   75s require a different PID/birth time, same installed executable and successful
   info. Keep the crash report and launchd restart observations. A manually reopened
   app cannot count. Repeat once, observing a new process each time. Do not run
   heartbeat/native apps yet; this phase isolates Agent persistence.

7. Select the app's ordinary Quit in this reserved session. This is the small
   unavoidable human AppKit action; no UI automation or screenshot is acceptance.
   Confirm clean exit and no Agent restart for 20s, with no successful info endpoint.
   Do not use bootout or SIGTERM to simulate ordinary Quit. Then actually log out
   and log back into the same reserved account, without invoking open. Within75s
   require launchd to start the Agent and info to work. Repeat after an owner-approved
   host reboot plus login; record changed boot session and new PID. A lock/unlock,
   shell exit or killing the process is not a logout/reboot substitute.

8. Record the app's Launch at Login preference and the OS approval state. Disable
   using the app's supported setting; require handoff to one unsupervised process
   and no registered launch-agent restart after it quits. Login again and require
   no automatic Agent. Reopen manually and restore the setting, then requalify
   supervision. If OS Login Items has explicitly denied approval, record the
   requiresApproval path and its refusal to silently register; only the owner may
   restore approval. A missing/denied environment remains not_run for positive
   supervision, not an automatic success or a request to bypass policy.

Update with a live native app: 1786 plus 2314 upgrade handoff

9. Reconfirm origin is running under launchd and its current signature/path/version.
   Generated deploy-heartbeat deploys only @APPID@ from @OUT@/heartbeat. It runs a
   shell counter for at most900s and appends trial/PID/counter to the owned
   @OUT@/heartbeat.log. No sensor, network server, credential or external service
   is used. Require at least five increasing counters with the exact trial, then
   record the native app PID and birth time from ps. The real app must also appear
   running in generated apps. Do not infer readiness from detached deploy success.

10. Run generated update; retain full stdout, stderr and status. It uploads the exact
    candidate ZIP, commits replacement, waits for the Agent and compares the new
    Agent's launch-time executable hash with the executable extracted from that ZIP.
    It must exit0 with JSON status success, never up-to-date, timeout or a version-only
    match. Current device info does not expose binary_sha256; do not invent that
    field. The pinned CLI's update verification is the RPC hash evidence. Separately
    verify installed executable @CANDIDATE@ and codesign after replacement, a new
    launchd PID/birth time, candidate version via info and exactly one Agent within75s.
    A disk hash alone cannot prove the old process stopped.

11. The native heartbeat must continue through this update with the same PID and
    birth time and increasing counter; no counter reset/new child is allowed.
    Require at least five fresh counters after Agent verification and list the app
    through the new Agent. Keep every row across the handoff and record pauses.
    This is the original failure boundary: update must not run ordinary Quit's
    native-app teardown or wedge on the active update RPC. Do not stop/redeploy the
    app to make this pass. Finish within the 900s fixture lifetime. Repeat a same-version
    update between independently built, different executable hashes if those reviewed
    packages are available; equal version strings cannot substitute for hash proof.

12. With no other work in the account, test the candidate's crash restart and real
    logout/login once more. Native PID preservation is required across self-update,
    not across an OS logout/reboot. Record real adoption/output after login separately.

Discriminating controls, requiring separately built signed packages

13. @OUT@/controls contains two source overlays; generation never signs or installs
    them. Build each independently from the exact candidate source in a separate
    disposable checkout using the recorded release build/sign/notarization recipe.
    For persistence control replace only the source launch-agent plist with generated
    sh.wendy.WendyAgentMac.plist: RunAtLoad true and KeepAlive false retain initial
    launch but remove crash supervision, the behavior missing before2314. Rebuild
    the embedded resource, sign and verify normally. Require an initially running
    registered job and successful info, then actual SIGABRT and no automatic restart
    for75s. A registration/signature/setup failure does not qualify this control.
    In the separate exact-source checkout, copy only the appropriate overlay to
    swift/WendyAgentMac/LaunchAgents/sh.wendy.WendyAgentMac.plist or
    swift/WendyAgentMac/Sources/AppDelegate.swift. Retain git diff and verify every
    other source against the candidate build record. The existing release entry is:
      make -C CONTROL_CHECKOUT/swift agent-release VERSION=REVIEWED_VERSION OUTPUT_DIR=FRESH_BUILD_OUTPUT
    Use only the owner's existing reviewed signing setup: Build.sh consumes
    KEYCHAIN_PATH, SIGNING_IDENTITY, NOTARY_PROFILE, APP_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_PATH
    and NET_PROXY_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_PATH as in the release workflow. Do not
    create/import credentials or bypass missing provisioning. Never use agent-start,
    reset settings/permissions or the --dev build as a substitute. Capture the
    produced signed ZIP/app and rerun the same identity/signature/archive checks.

14. For update control replace only WendyAgentMac/Sources/AppDelegate.swift with
    generated AppDelegate.swift. It restores the original1786 update handler's call
    to performQuit instead of performUpdateQuit. Retain current protocol and package
    layout. Install this signed control as the running ORIGIN, then deploy the native
    heartbeat and update to the unmodified candidate. Require actual accepted upload
    and evidence that the old native PID stopped/counter ceased or the update hung
    after commit; an authentication/upload/signature refusal is not sensitivity.
    Restore the unmodified origin and repeat the identical case successfully.
    Archive each control's exact source overlay, build log, signed app/ZIP hashes
    and before/after process transcript. Until qualified control packages are built
    and these failures observed, historical-controls remains not_run. The actual
    45s watchdog process control is separate; it cannot prove the AppKit/launchd path.

Restoration and retained evidence

15. Stop/remove only @APPID@ with generated remove-heartbeat; require no remaining
    fixture native PID and counters stopped. Disable Launch at Login through the
    app and quit normally; require the exact job unregistered/no running process.
    Do not delete an installed bundle while its job is active. Archive evidence
    before removing this trial's installed bundle and output. The account owner may
    then remove the disposable account using the ordinary approved system procedure.
    Do not delete another account, launchd label, app, preference domain or Keychain.
    If update leaves the Agent unreachable, use the reserved recovery session and
    approved original package; preserve failure logs before any reinstall. Record
    recovery as recovery, never a passing restart. Unproven cleanup stays failed.

16. Attach OS/build/signature/identity records, every actual command/exit, PID+birth
    transitions, launchd registration/error observations, CLI update hash-verification
    outcome and continuous heartbeat rows. Assign pass only to individually observed
    cases; unfinished login, denial, controls, reboot or cleanup remains not_run.
    Logs and packages may contain local paths: retain them in the private review
    artifact store, never commit signing material or screenshots to the repository.
